select.title: Select a Tenant
select.subtitle: Choose a tenant to manage or create a new one to get started.
select.operatorNote: As an operator you enter a tenant through support access: give a reason, and the tenant’s audit log records that you entered, why, and what you changed.

support.opened: Support access to {{name}} opened for an hour
